operator_request: Remediate every reported spot-check finding, then commit, push, and provide an overview of remaining work.

research_reopen_triggers: The Operator explicitly requests new research.
The locked Serde behavior, Rust toolchain, dependency set, or architecture harness assumption is proven stale.
A decision lacks evidence in the design, WP-005, WP-013, archived WP-014 revisions, current source, or reproduced behavior.
existing_research_sources: WP-013 current Rust and Serde implementation research
Current storage, testkit, architecture mapping, and gate implementation
Direct public deserialization reproductions and prior WP-014 test and gate reports
selected_approach: Preserve the implemented Serde and validation remediation.
Preserve three distinct public-boundary mutation fixtures.
Archive invalid packet revisions with their diagnostics.
Start v3 with a safe immutable prerequisite object and rerun canonical checks.
rejected_options: Backfilling or mutating the prerequisite object after activation.
Adding dependencies or changing valid wire shape.
reuse_opportunities: Reuse every prior WP-014 code change, test, fixture, and report.
Reuse the WP-013 supersession and prerequisite wording patterns.
Reuse the truth gate's activation comparison as the independent packet check.
basis.validation_plan: Commit v3 with its prerequisite object present and unchanged, run prerequisite and PR checks, inspect the full base-to-head diff and exact boundary reports independently, record findings and residual uncertainty, then execute closure and main-containment proof.

assumptions: The locked dependency and toolchain basis remains current.
The established journal JSON shape is authoritative.
Prior WP-014 implementation commits remain within v3 base-to-head scope.
non_goals: Changing valid durable-wire tags or fields.
Creating an entrypoint or advancing product state.

minimum_controls: Invalid cases cross public serde_json boundaries.
Canonical records round-trip to equal JSON.
Each guard has a distinct isolated mutation.
The architecture gate executes all mapped fixtures.
The prerequisite object is verified against the first v3 commit.
plausible_failures: A guard disappears without a gate failure.
A mutation runs zero tests or fails elsewhere.
Packet prose or object drift creates a false prerequisite claim.

execution_decomposition: Perform independent adversarial review and record evidence.
Commit closure, merge, prove containment, push, and report remaining work.
